added.description:
The names of all Types or fields that were added to the package between two versions.

For fields, it's possible only a [declaration](DeclaredFieldType) was added, not a net-new
field. In the following example, a declaration of the `name` field was added, but the `name`
field is not new; it just has an inherited declaration to change the {@link ValueModifier}.

```type
┌──────────────────┬──────────────────┐
│      1.0.0       │      2.0.0       │
├──────────────────┼──────────────────┤
│ type B mixes A   │ type B mixes A { │
│                  │   name: !~       │
│                  │ }                │
└──────────────────┴──────────────────┘
```

Individual [metrics](BaseCodeAnalysis.VersionDiff.Metric) are responsible for handling
inherited declarations

removed.description:
The names of all Types or fields that were removed from the package between two versions.

For fields, it's possible only a [declaration](DeclaredFieldType) was removed, not the field
itself. In the following example, the `name` field was removed, but the `name` field is not
gone; it just removed an inherited declaration to change the {@link ValueModifier}.

```type
┌──────────────────┬──────────────────┐
│      1.0.0       │      2.0.0       │
├──────────────────┼──────────────────┤
│ type B mixes A { │ type B mixes A   │
│   name: !~       │                  │
│ }                │                  │
└──────────────────┴──────────────────┘
```

revised.description:
A map of all Types or fields that were renamed or deprecated between the two versions.
The key is the old name and the value is all relevant details about the rename. Both
deprecations and renames are stored here because they overlap. A Type or field can be
deprecated, renamed, or both.

touched.description:
The names of all Types that are present in both versions and have been changed in any way.
A Type is considered touched if any part of its declaration changed (i.e., the output of
{@link BaseCodeAnalysis.VersionDiff#getOrderedTypeMetaStr} is different across versions).

This does **not** include changes to documentation or changing the order of declared fields.

This is a superset of the keys of #revised. Any revised Type is also touched, but not all
touched Types are revised.

fieldChanges.description: A map of Type name to any field changes within that Type.

title:
The result of {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.VersionDiff#detectStructuralChanges}. This Type lists
all the Types (and their fields) that were changed between two {@link Pkg#version}s.

Type changes are binned by the kind of change (#added, #removed, #revised, #touched). Within each
Type, if any fields or method were changed, these changes are recorded in the #fieldChanges field.
name: BaseCodeAnalysis.VersionDiff.TypeMetaChanges
